ov: Hoofed plant-eaters whose males, in almost every species, grow and shed a new set of bony antlers every year. Reindeer are the only deer in which females grow antlers too.

why.dg: Mostly on the road: in the US, collisions with deer kill about 150 people a year.
why.et: Hunted for meat, and northern peoples herd reindeer for food, clothing and transport.

rg: Native to every continent except Antarctica and Australia; Africa has only one native deer, the Barbary stag.
df: Plants: grasses, weeds, herbs and the leaves and shoots of woody plants.
fx: The only male deer that don’t grow antlers are water deer.

_cf.tip: In most deer only the males grow antlers; in reindeer, females can grow them too.
